project.name: Apache Sourcelume Registry - Validation Plugin: SHACL (Apache Jena)
project.description:
SHACL validation plugin for ProvenanceRecord documents, built on Apache Jena SHACL 6.x (JSON-LD parsing via Titanium).
Part of the modular RecordValidator plugin architecture: this module provides the semantic validation stage ("shacl", order 200) and registers itself via META-INF/services. It inlines the bundled JSON-LD context from sourcelume-spec (no remote context fetching — records submitted with a relative context reference are resolved locally) and runs the spec's SHACL shapes (sourcelume.shacl.ttl) against the expanded RDF graph.
Heavier than the JSON Schema plugin by design (~18 MB of Jena dependencies); consumers that do not need RDF-level validation can omit this module from their deployment.
NOTE (ASF licensing): jena-shacl transitively depends on org.glassfish:jakarta.json (EPL-2.0 / GPL-2.0 with Classpath Exception), an ASF category-B dependency. Acceptable for binary distribution, but it must be listed in LICENSE/NOTICE when bundling.
